reason: The public proposition, client/student navigation, engagement terms, preparation guidance and restrained Precision Instrument hierarchy are coherent in the supplied homepage captures. I traced the client journey from services and pro-bono FAQ to the contact form, and the student journey through recruitment status, preparation and evaluation criteria. Public canonical/social metadata and request-time case publication have credible local evidence; the empty approved-project list avoids fabricated results. However, recruitment empty states assert facts they cannot establish and offer an unusable signup when no cycle exists. These undermine first-encounter trust and merit correction before release. This is an independent simulated AI assessment of source, captures and supplied local evidence, not observed human task success or hosted acceptance.

findings.evidence: fetchPublicRecruitment discards the RPC error and returns {cycle:null} when data is absent. Join defaults missing events to [] and states "The Board has not published events for this cycle yet." Thus a failed read, or no cycle, becomes an unsupported statement about Board publication.
findings.userImpact: A prospective student can mistake unavailable published dates for an intentional absence and defer applying.
findings.suggestedFix: Represent unavailable, no-cycle and successfully loaded empty-event states separately; use neutral outage wording with retry/contact guidance, and reserve the Board-publication statement for a successful read.

findings.evidence: When recruitment.cycle is null, showInterestForm is true and the primary action invites recruitment updates. submit_interest requires a DRAFT/OPEN/IN_PROCESS cycle and raises "recruitment is not open" when none exists. The normal no-cycle state therefore advertises a signup the database rejects.
findings.userImpact: A student following the prominent next step supplies personal information without being able to register for updates.
findings.suggestedFix: Support an explicitly approved cycle-independent interest list, or suppress the form when no cycle exists and offer the Board email as the working next step. Add a focused no-cycle journey check.

notVerified: No staging, deployment or hosted Clerk/Supabase/storage/email acceptance exists. The contact journey test intercepts HTTP success; it does not prove Board delivery.
No real students/clients, assistive technology, physical devices, Safari or Firefox were observed. Supplied captures cover homepage craft, not the rendered Join empty states.
Publication proof uses a synthetic HTTP fixture; it does not establish hosted RLS, actual client approval, search-engine indexing or social-platform cache withdrawal.

Client-approved outcomes/artifacts remain absent. Membership workload is not quantified publicly; the FAQ directs students to ask members. Actual current facts, dates and Board policy approval were not independently verified.
